scope: Consolidated implemented change groups present in the current local working tree since its last recorded release. Count one coherent behavior or authored content batch once, even when mentioned by multiple recommendation lists. Individual source URLs, essay paragraphs, reviewed questions, test cases and changed files are not separately counted as improvements. Already-existing behavior merely rechecked is excluded. Tutor prompt changes are implemented instructions, not proof of evaluated live response quality. This is a defined grouping count, not an objective feature-unit metric.
